# Generated-data catalog

Every file under `results/` is distributed with the computational research package. All patient- and service-level records are simulated; no participant records or clinic exports were used. Numeric data have been retained from the provided research archive without recomputation for this repository reorganization.

**Total generated files:** 52. **Total uncompressed size:** 25,830,572 bytes.

## Statistical notes

The empirical 2.5th–97.5th percentile range of individual model replications is distinct from the BCa confidence interval for the expected mean. Sensitivity-index intervals describe numerical design uncertainty under the chosen input distributions. The 1,024-point Sobol design under `results/global_sensitivity/` is the main analysis; the smaller design under `results/global_sensitivity_screening/` is retained as a separate diagnostic experiment.
